changes: A compact, resizable workspace starts at 900 x 600. Settings Appearance offers window-size presets and 100% or 125% UI scale when they fit your display, with preferences remembered locally across openings.
Export now offers independent Dry and Wet levels with presets, continuous level preview and gain provenance for exported files. First use defaults to Dry 0% and Wet 100%.
Settings About shows the running build and full source revision, with copy feedback for bug reports. Copy diagnostics includes separate Snap-grid and live playback timing evidence.
Each release ZIP now includes these build-specific release notes alongside the illustrated offline user guide.
fixes: Improved Perform waveform drawing and detail when zoomed in, with less repeated waveform preparation during editor refresh.
Selecting a swell from the list automatically fits its context into view. The Perform transport readout keeps stable field positions while playback advances.
New wet renders use a short source-edge taper to reduce sharp cut-edge excitation, including when swells overlap. Captured audio and dry playback are preserved.
Snap stays available with a stable validated playback-clock offset in fixed-tempo projects; Play and Stop do not move the captured editing grid.
Fixed-tempo DAW offline rendering validates its own bounce clock, handling a stable source-to-export origin difference without moving accepted swell audio.
upgradeSteps: Close your DAW and preserve the previous complete VST3 bundle before replacing it with the complete ReverbArise.vst3 folder. Rescan in FL Studio and open a copy of an existing project first.

Existing verified wet renders keep their saved sound. Use Regenerate All once to upgrade older unfrozen swells to source-edge conditioning; no recapture is needed. Frozen swells retain saved audio until explicitly unfrozen and regenerated.
Older unversioned Export preferences reset to Dry 0% and Wet 100% when migrated. Existing export history and files remain preserved; check the levels before preparing another export.
knownLimitations: This is an unsigned Windows x64 VST3 alpha with manual installation. Clean-machine, second-host and physical DPI coverage remains limited; this exact package still needs its final FL Studio smoke test.
The timing repairs cover fixed tempo and meter. Tempo automation and genuine changes within a playback or bounce clock remain outside that repair and can make Snap or wet playback unavailable.

FL Studio Song/Pattern mode and source-mute state cannot be reliably distinguished by the plugin. Follow the Perform playback caution; source silence alone does not establish the intended host workflow.
Source-edge conditioning reduces one source of sharp transients; it does not guarantee removal of all artifacts or overload. Start at low monitoring volume.

If prepared swells go silent, preserve the project and assets, then copy diagnostics while the symptom is happening and again after Stop. A working Snap grid alone does not prove wet playback was admitted.
